description: Sound thesis: complete introduction, hypotheses answered in the conclusions, 27 sources with 11 foreign. Planted: bibliography out of alphabetical order from entry 14, and tables without a list of tables. Mostly a test of what a model invents.

metadata.author: Anna Kowalczyk
metadata.title: Determinanty oszczędzania gospodarstw domowych w Polsce w latach 2010–2022

expected.issue: The bibliography is not in alphabetical order: entries 14 onwards (Attanasio, Bańbuła, Carroll…) restart the alphabet after Thaler.
The thesis contains tables (Tabela 1, Tabela 2) but has no list of tables.

must_not_flag: The introduction has no research question or no hypotheses.
The research methods are not described.
The bibliography has fewer than 25 sources.
There are fewer than four foreign-language sources.
The conclusions do not say whether the hypotheses were confirmed.
The empirical sample is too small or not described.
